				create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = LAK }
			}
			if = { limit = { country_exists = THB NOT = { has_war_with = THB } }
				create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = THB }
			}
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = ATH } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = LAK } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = THB } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = KRN } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = AGS } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = EUB } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = THL } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			every_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = MKD } add_claim_by = ROOT }
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}

	focus = {
		id = PRS_s_king_of_europe
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_major_alliance
		prerequisite = { focus = PRS_s_pontic_cities focus = PRS_s_illyria }
		prerequisite = { focus = PRS_s_hellas }
		x = 13
		y = 5
		cost = 15
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
		available_if_capitulated = yes
		completion_reward = {
			log = "ANTE|[GetDateText]|focus|[ROOT.GetTag]|PRS_s_king_of_europe"
			add_political_power = 150
			add_war_support = 0.10
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 3 }
	}

	focus = {
		id = PRS_s_new_dynasty
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_national_unity
		prerequisite = { focus = PRS_s_king_of_europe }
		prerequisite = { focus = PRS_s_arabaya }
		prerequisite = { focus = PRS_s_pactolus }
		x = 7
		y = 6
		cost = 20
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
		available_if_capitulated = yes
		completion_reward = {
			log = "ANTE|[GetDateText]|focus|[ROOT.GetTag]|PRS_s_new_dynasty"
			add_ideas = PRS_s_new_dynasty_spirit
			add_research_slot = 1
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 3 }
	}

}
